_doc: Machine-readable registry of Cracker forward-registered hypotheses and sensitivity items. Append-only in spirit — entries may gain a 'resolution' but never be edited or removed. The git history of this file + docs/cracker-ledger.md is the tamper-evident record. Phase-5/8 runners consume this file; do not rely on session memory.

forward-lockbox.testSet: cracker-trace.db (L3 mini), days > 2026-07-07, untouched until Phase 5
forward-lockbox.correction: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.10 across all OPEN entries in this family at resolution time

hypotheses.claim: IC(absorb_ratio, y(1m)) < 0 on real-source visits (high contact absorption predicts 1m continuation INTO the level)

resolution.verdict: GENERAL-TAPE — BH-rejected with declared sign (p=0.0585) but FAILED the registered twin gate (twin -0.044 vs real -0.039): effect is real but not level-specific. Rejected as a level factor; retained as a tape-state candidate for Phase-6 composition.

hypotheses.claim: IC_twin(dStar/ct_vol, 5m) - IC_real(dStar/ct_vol, 5m) > 0 (flow-following works at arbitrary prices, is neutralized/reversed at real structure)

resolution.verdict: CONFIRMED — +0.040, one-sided p=0.0558, BH q=0.10 (step-up). Small effect; FINAL word owed by the forward-lockbox re-test at Phase 5 (entry F5b-fwd below).

hypotheses.claim: Replication of F5b on the L3 forward lockbox: IC_twin(dStar/ct_vol, 5m) - IC_real(dStar/ct_vol, 5m) > 0
Sweep-exhaustion, level-agnostic (real+placebo pooled): IC(sweep, y(5m)) < 0 on swept-and-reclaimed visits (deep-fast spike-reclaims predict LESS follow-through)

The recurring sub-MDE 'NQ 5m structure bounce': hvn-vs-placebo dy(5m) > 0 (F1 shape: +4.3/+4.6pt train/valid) AND stacked-vs-lone confluence dy(5m) > 0 (F2 shape: +6.1/+7.1pt). Two-part claim, both parts must hold sign.

Replenishment intensity (fill->repost <=1.5s count at the defending zone during the visit) predicts 1m continuation INTO the level: IC(refills, y(1m)) < 0 on ES real-source visits (emergent from F11's undeclared-horizon cell: train -0.062 sig / valid -0.060 sig, twin n.s.)

sensitivityItems.claim: Visit trigger band (= sigma_1m, avg ~18pt NQ in this regime) may DILUTE effects via drive-by visits. Re-run ladder survivors (F5b) and headline nulls (F6, F8) at band in {0.5*sigma_1m, min(sigma_1m, 8pt NQ / 2pt ES)}.
